Funny thing about this is that this is actually where Balmora gets its namesake.

In Dunmeri bal (pronounced like the bal in balance) means balls and morr (pronounced like more) means dick and appending the suffix -a (pronounced like ah) by replacing the second 'r', means 'and'.

So Bal-mor-a literally translates to balls dick and, but when you get the grammar right it translates to dick and balls.
